skill_name: Create a simple web application with a user interface.
workflow: The web application will allow customers to select the type of service they need, as well as the time and date of the service. It will also require them to provide basic information such as name, email, and phone number. It will provide customers with an interface to view their appointment details, including any notes they enter while making the booking. Finally, it will allow customers to make payment via their preferred payment method.
